approved_by.description: Identity of the approving analyst. Defaults to 'analyst'.
approved_by.title: Approved By

candidate.description: An isolation or account disable: the id of the stored candidate (parameters.containment.candidates) to act on. May be omitted when there is one.
candidate.title: Candidate

AuditEntry.description: One trail entry. Columns beside the envelope pass through.
AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry

AuditFeedHealth.description: The feed as the Audit section sees it: no host, no certificates.
AuditFeedHealth.title: AuditFeedHealth

AuditPayload.description: The hashed record. Open per action: other keys pass through.
AuditPayload.title: AuditPayload

AuditPollPage.description:
Entries after the cursor, or ``reset`` with the latest restore entry
when the cursor is past the tip. Only the keys of the case in hand are sent.
AuditPollPage.title: AuditPollPage

AuditPrincipal.description: A principal an entry names, read from principals when the entry is read.
AuditPrincipal.title: AuditPrincipal

AuditTip.description: The newest entry, or the anchor when the trail is empty.
AuditTip.title: AuditTip

CaseClosureView.description: What the closed summary shows. ``verdict`` is the stated reason.
CaseClosureView.title: CaseClosureView

CaseConflictResponse.description: A refused edit. Nothing was written.
CaseConflictResponse.title: CaseConflictResponse

CaseCreate.description:
Case creation request.

``restricted`` (or a ``readers`` or ``reader_teams`` list) creates the case
restricted in the same insert, so its content is never open. ``readers`` are
principal ids; left out, the list is the defaults (you, when you are a person
or service account). ``reader_teams`` are team ids whose members read it:
naming one is a person's own act and needs users.read; never the default team.
CaseCreate.title: CaseCreate

CaseDetailResponse.description: ``GET /cases/{id}`` — the case, its combined state, and the runs on it.
CaseDetailResponse.title: CaseDetailResponse

CaseExpected.description:
The values a caller last saw, for the fields it means to change.

A field left out is not compared. Per field, not ``updated_at``: agents and
runs touch a case throughout an investigation, so a whole-row version would
refuse every edit made during a run.
CaseExpected.title: CaseExpected

CaseFieldConflict.description: One field whose stored value is not what the caller last saw.
CaseFieldConflict.title: CaseFieldConflict

CaseInvestigationRef.description:
One run on the case page: an investigation, or a run started on the case
with no investigation row (``investigation_id`` null). Newest first.
CaseInvestigationRef.title: CaseInvestigationRef

CaseLinkedFinding.description: One finding the case already links, and the source door when one exists.
CaseLinkedFinding.title: CaseLinkedFinding

CaseOwner.description: One stored owner on a readable case: the value as stored, and its state.
CaseOwner.title: CaseOwner

CaseOwnersResponse.description: Distinct non-blank owners on cases the reader can list, closed included.
CaseOwnersResponse.title: CaseOwnersResponse

CaseQueueItem.description:
One row of the case queue.

``case_id`` and ``title`` stay so callers that only need a picker
(the workflow start dialog) can keep reading the list.
CaseQueueItem.title: CaseQueueItem

CaseQueueStrip.description: Counts for the queue strip. Independent of the page filters.
CaseQueueStrip.title: CaseQueueStrip

CaseRuleCard.description: One rule version behind a case's alerts, and its stored checks.
CaseRuleCard.title: CaseRuleCard

CaseRulesResponse.description: ``GET /cases/{id}/rules`` — worst first; alerts traced to no rule apart.
CaseRulesResponse.title: CaseRulesResponse

CaseSchema.description: Default shape — findings referenced by id.
CaseSchema.title: CaseSchema

CaseSuccessResponse.description: Mutation that only reports whether it landed.
CaseSuccessResponse.title: CaseSuccessResponse

CaseTeam.description: The case's owning team, on reads.
CaseTeam.title: CaseTeam

CeilingBody.description:
A partial edit of the stored ceiling. Omitted flags stay as they are.

``stopped`` is not a field here. Stop is ``POST /api/orchestrator/kill``
and resume is ``POST /api/autonomy/resume``.
CeilingBody.title: CeilingBody

ClosureCategory.description:
What closing the Case determined.

``UNSPECIFIED`` is the one that is not a determination. It exists because
the console closes a Case by setting its status and asks for no category,
and the alternative to recording that plainly is either dropping the close
from memory or picking a determination on the analyst's behalf. Recorded, it
reads as what it is — closed, no reason stated — and becomes an inconclusive
Verdict rather than a claim nobody made.
ClosureCategory.title: ClosureCategory

ClosureInfo.description:
Close case with metadata.

No ``closed_by`` and no channel: who closed it, and whether that was the
console cookie, come from the session. A client-supplied name or kind
would let any caller claim an analyst concluded.
ClosureInfo.title: ClosureInfo

actor.description: Who is steering. Defaults to the session user.
actor.title: Actor

fields.description: Any of checkpoint_id, entity_key, question_id, hypothesis_id, tenant, revoke, grant.
fields.title: Fields

kind.description: One of note, lead, abort, extend, conclude, approve, reject, benign, gap, boost.
kind.title: Kind

text.description: What the operator is telling the run.
text.title: Text

EntityContext.description: Free-form entity context; ``source_evidence`` is the one named key.
EntityContext.title: EntityContext

collected_by.description: Ignored: the signed-in user is recorded as the collector.
collected_by.title: Collected By

FalsePositiveCause.description:
Which kind of fix a false-positive determination is.

It refines a ``false_positive`` close and a noise mark. Absence is a null
column, not a member: ``not_given`` is not stored.
FalsePositiveCause.title: FalsePositiveCause

FindingRecord.description:
A finding as the API returns it.

``FindingSchema`` stays in the storage tier, which may not import the
findings domain, so the evidence type is narrowed here.
FindingRecord.title: FindingRecord

HeldAction.description: One approved outside action a stop is still holding.
HeldAction.title: HeldAction

IOCMark.description:
Mark or clear an indicator as a false positive on this case.

Named by type and value, not id: an indicator a linked alert names has none.
IOCMark.title: IOCMark

MergeRequest.description: Merge another case into this one.
MergeRequest.title: MergeRequest

args.description: That call's arguments, verbatim: approving releases exactly these.
args.title: Args

case_id.description: The first of case_ids: the case that asked.
case_id.title: Case Id

case_ids.description: Every case this item is on. A proposal several cases made is one item listing them all.
case_ids.title: Case Ids

checkpoint_id.description: The run's own checkpoint this item answers, so a page reading the run can tell it was answered.
checkpoint_id.title: Checkpoint Id

containment.description: An isolation or account disable: the vendor IDs its target resolved to (candidates), or which tool is missing (missing).
containment.title: Containment

created_at.description: '' when nothing recorded when it started waiting.
created_at.title: Created At

finding_id.description: The first stored alert the approval's evidence names, so an item with no case can open it.
finding_id.title: Finding Id

hypotheses.description: A hypothesis approval's explanations, each with where it came from; base_rate is the benign one to beat.
hypotheses.title: Hypotheses

kind.description: recommendation: a pending action nothing in Vigil executes, answered by acting in your own tools and closing its case. parked: a hunt stopped at a limit, answered with Keep going on its case; its source_id is the run id. open_case: a demo-mode case that is not closed, answered by opening the case; its source_id is the case id.
kind.title: Kind

restricted.description: An item on a restricted case the caller can't read: no case, run or content.
restricted.title: Restricted

step_score.description: A containment an investigation filed: its step score's value, band ('none' when no factor is in force, 'unknown' when value is null), lowest factor, the line on what would raise it, and the factors.
step_score.title: Step Score

tool.description: The gated tool call this approval releases.
tool.title: Tool

waiting.description: Why it waits: no reader of its restricted case can approve it.
waiting.title: Waiting

PendingActionResponse.description:
Frozen shape of an approval action.

Value types are permissive where the underlying dataclass carries open JSON
(evidence, parameters, execution_result); the key set is the promise.

confidence.description: The step score's value (parameters.step_score.value) on a containment an investigation filed; null on a row without one.
confidence.title: Confidence

held.description: An approved action a stop is holding: releasing the hold runs it.
held.title: Held

restricted.description: An action on a restricted case the caller can't read: only its id, state and times are shown.
restricted.title: Restricted

waiting.description: Why a pending action waits: no reader of its restricted case can approve it.
waiting.title: Waiting

PendingActionResponse.title: PendingActionResponse

RecheckMarkView.description: The one mark on a Case opened from a re-check.
RecheckMarkView.title: RecheckMarkView

reason.description: Why the action is being rejected.
reason.title: Reason

rejected_by.description: Identity of the rejecting analyst. Defaults to 'analyst'.
rejected_by.title: Rejected By

run_kind.description: hunt, lead, compose, ... — from the run's trigger.
run_kind.title: Run Kind

count.description: Number of runs in this page.
count.title: Count

hidden.description: Runs that matched but are on a restricted case the caller can't read, left out.
hidden.title: Hidden

events.description: Events on the ledger, so progress is visible.
events.title: Events

SourceEvidence.description:
The envelope ``normalize_source_evidence`` returns.

Payload fields are present only when ``status`` is ``available``; list
responses drop ``records``/``raw_text`` and set ``payload_included: false``.
SourceEvidence.title: SourceEvidence

arch.description: Must be empty: the arch comes from the run-kind registry.
arch.title: Arch

config.description: Must be empty: the workflow reference carries its config.
config.title: Config

overrides.description: Per-run budgets and runtime limits. The dollar ceiling (budgets.max_cost_usd) is checked before each model call, so a run can end above it by the cost of the call it was making (which can include retries). Calls that couldn't be priced (up to 3), calls whose usage had to be estimated, and requests a provider billed but Vigil recorded as nothing aren't fully counted. The allowance starts again when a run resumes.
overrides.title: Overrides

playbook.description: A workflow reference, workflow:<id>, naming an enabled workflow.
playbook.title: Playbook

prompt.description: What the run is being asked to do.
prompt.title: Prompt

run_kind.description: One of hunt, root_cause, adjudicate, investigate, compose, chat.
run_kind.title: Run Kind

tenant_id.description: Accepted and ignored: Vigil has no tenant model.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

ToolClassEntry.description:
One outside tool. ``effect_class`` is None while it is unclassified or
withdrawn.
ToolClassEntry.title: ToolClassEntry

ToolDefinition.description: A tool as its server lists it: what a model reads, and what is pinned.
ToolDefinition.title: ToolDefinition

reason.title: Reason
